newsitem.title: UK: UK 1996 drug exports seen at record 6 billion stg.
newsitem.headline: UK 1996 drug exports seen at record 6 billion stg.

text.p: Exports of drugs from the UK are expected to have totalled a record six billion stg in 1996, the Association of the British Pharmaceutical Industry (ABPI) said on Thursday.

In its 1996 annual review, the association said that based on nine-month figures, the industry was expected to show a trade surplus of a record 2.7 billion stg, with growth in exports outstripping growth in imports.

ABPI director-general Trevor Jones said "the trade surplus had increased year-on-year over a long period of time. Provided no new restrictions are placed on companies I confidently forecast that the pharmaceutical industry is on track to become the biggest single money earner for Britain."
The ABPI estimated that the industry spent 2.0 billion stg on research and development in Britain last year, accounting for a nearly a quarter of the UK total. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
